title: Cut Susi Tools code no Susi development uses; add local-harvest notices
goal: Every line of Susi Tools traces to Susi's development (CEO, 2026-11-22). An audit of 2026-11-23 found commands, options and read paths nothing calls: cut them, with their tests and docs. Fix what the audit suspected in tasks list (a stale local main) and in the hooks (the index a partial commit uses). Add the local-harvest notices command that Susi's ledger, its release gate and the audit tell people to run, which fails on Linux today.
